_about: Public-domain George Albert Coe (1862-1951), Methodist psychologist of religion and religious educator at Northwestern, Union Seminary and Teachers College, for the Word Hoard: his books printed before 1930: The Spiritual Life, The Religion of a Mature Mind, Education in Religion and Morals, Can Religion be Taught?, The Psychology of Religion, A Social Theory of Religious Education, What Ails our Youth?, The Motives of Men and What is Christian Education? Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 93 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
